notes.title: Update Preview – October 2021
notes.notes:
Hello, dreamers!
In today’s post, I’d like to share a preview of the exciting new content coming to the game this October!

[h1]New Class: Sylfie, the Electric[/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/5eb6830f79cc46b61b2a9d9a1279e43c0cc7b704.png[/img]

An athlete that has grown bored of her mundane everyday, Sylfie can amass energy to shock foes and deal massive damage, getting the thrill she seeks! Sylfie is another gauntlet user, but unlike Sakia, is focused on attacking rather than support!

For those of you that would like to prepare for her arrival, ability books and gifts for Sylfie already are available in-game!

[h1]New Quest Type: Digital Training Grounds[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/b8073bbfd6d3b6f68b8f6ecb86e037a7eee7b06d.png[/img]

The digital training grounds were created by Eucreta to allow for a safe way of training. Safe as it may be, the trainings are tough as nails! Passing a training will grant you a grand one-time reward and allow you to proceed to the next, the difficulty ever rising! By the way, seems Eucreta disabled the use of items for these…

The digital training grounds will be unlocked upon clearing the first main quest. On release 10 trainings will be available, and more will be added over time!

Today’s major update continues the expansion of the Tower and makes way for passive abilities for all classes!
